description: This Java class manages a MIDI output port selection UI component, handling device connection, port opening, and message sending via MidiDispatcher.

classes.name: MidiOutputPortSelector
classes.description: A class for selecting and managing a MIDI output port, including device connection and message dispatching.

methods.name: MidiOutputPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the selector with MIDI manager, activity, and UI spinner ID.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Handles the event when a MIDI port is selected, opening the device and port, and connecting the dispatcher.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Closes the MIDI port and device, disconnecting the dispatcher and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the MidiSender associated with the dispatcher for sending MIDI messages.
